answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29372 Country: India Title: I stay in Mumbai at Rented Home with my brother & his family since last 6 years. My question is that when I go to my native home(once or twice in year) in Deogad which is 500 kms away & intend to stay there less than 15 days, in this case, Should I offer Qasar Salah or Regular? Question: Assalamalaikum. I stay in Mumbai at Rented Home with my brother & his family since last 6 years. My question is that when I go to my native home(once or twice in year) in Deogad which is 500 kms away & intend to stay there less than 15 days, in this case, Should I offer Qasar Salah or Regular? Jazakallahu Khair. Answer ID: 29372 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 205/205/M=1432) In the question mentioned above, Deogad is your native place; hence you will have to offer full salah though you intend to stay there less than fifteen days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
